name: commerce-integration-core
description: Backend integration platform for supplier catalog ingestion, policy enforcement, inventory processing, webhooks, and order/SLA monitoring across multiple commerce channels.

scripts.test: tsx --test src/policy/shipping.test.ts src/policy/sla.test.ts src/policy/product-research.test.ts src/connectors/listing-mapper.test.ts src/connectors/cj.test.ts src/webhooks/hmac.test.ts src/serverless/handler.test.ts src/serverless/store.test.ts src/serverless/secret.test.ts
scripts.build:serverless: esbuild src/serverless/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --out-extension:.js=.mjs --entry-names=index --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=serverless-dist
